summary: Iteration 13 fully verified. Backend (10/10 pytest passed): Cart offer SKU isolation working — POST /api/offers/cart for a single Bosch product returns exactly 1 offer (the SKU-scoped no_cost_emi) — no leakage from 442 offers. New offer types (seasonal_offer, upi_offer) accepted by POST /api/offers/admin/create and persisted with correct offer_type. Brand-wide seasonal_offer created for Bosch/Refrigerator appears on Bosch KGN56LB42I PDP alongside its SKU offer, and also on the cart offers endpoint. Total 442 Bosch offers preserved after cleanup. Frontend: PDP renders seasonal_offer card with rose 'Limited Time' badge and green 'Contact store on WhatsApp' CTA (data-testid=offer-whatsapp-<id>) with correct href starting https://wa.me/919844577440?text=. Checkout /checkout now renders OffersDisplay in RIGHT column BELOW the payment method (measured: offers_top=693 > payment_bottom=669) — only 2 relevant Bosch offers shown, no leakage. Admin Add Offer modal dropdown shows all 8 offer types in correct order (Cashback, Bank Offer, No Cost EMI, UPI Cashback / Offer, Exchange Offer, Extended Warranty, Limited Time / Seasonal Offer, Partner Offer).
critical_code_review_comments: OFFER_TYPES whitelist in cashback_offers_routes.py now includes 8 types; POST /admin/create validates against it (good).
OfferUpdate model still does NOT whitelist offer_type on PUT — any string could be persisted via update. Consider adding whitelist validation there too. (Carried from iter 12.)
The cart endpoint uses the same non_sku_filter as offers_for_product — good DRY approach, though the filter is duplicated inline; could be extracted to a shared helper.
OffersDisplay.js: when redeem_location != 'offline_store', WhatsApp CTA is hidden but backend still sends the whatsapp_message field — harmless bandwidth cost, minor.
Checkout.js at line ~956 correctly passes cartProductIds via product?.id fallback — handles both nested and flat cart shapes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (PDP + Checkout position + WhatsApp CTA + 8-type dropdown all verified)
